headlines.headline: KAWHI LEONARD-TO-RAPTORS TRADE DETAILS REVEALED: CLIPPERS GET BRANDON INGRAM, GRADEY DICK, FIVE PICKS
headlines.detail: With the trade appearing imminent pending final league paperwork, reported terms have Toronto sending Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, and a package of picks — unprotected 2031 and 2033 firsts, 2030 and 2033 seconds, and a 2027 first-round swap — to the Clippers for Kawhi Leonard, who returns to the franchise he led to the 2019 title now that L.A.'s salary-cap circumvention penalties have cleared the way.

headlines.headline: TUA TAGOVAILOA OFFICIALLY NAMED FALCONS' WEEK 1 STARTER OVER INJURED MICHAEL PENIX JR.
headlines.detail: Atlanta officially handed the keys to its offense to Tua Tagovailoa for the season opener against Pittsburgh, signed on a one-year, near-minimum deal after Miami released him, while first-round pick Michael Penix Jr. continues recovering from a season-ending ACL injury.

headlines.headline: MICHIGAN NEEDS CONTROVERSIAL HAIL MARY TO ESCAPE WESTERN MICHIGAN 13-12 AS LSU ROUTS CLEMSON 51-10
headlines.detail: Michigan avoided a Week 1 upset only after an extra second was put back on the clock for a game-winning Hail Mary against Western Michigan, while LSU throttled Clemson 51-10 and No. 1 Ohio State routed Ball State 56-3 behind Julian Sayin's 320 yards and three touchdowns.

headlines.headline: DEFENDING CHAMP MICHIGAN SLIDES IN EARLY POLLS AFTER LOSING FIVE-STAR BIG MAN TO INJURY
headlines.detail: March's national champion Michigan dropped in CBS Sports' early Top 25 And 1 rankings after five-star freshman big man Brandon McCoy Jr. went down with an injury, while four-star 2027 guard Tre Keith's commitment to Boston College headlined weekend recruiting news.
